_doc: SINGLE SOURCE for the frontmatter `type::` vocabulary of files under outputs/raw/. Do NOT duplicate this list elsewhere. A hallucination sampler can derive its sampling set from substantive:true here; a post-session audit can flag any recent raw output whose type is missing or absent from this registry. When a new type is first emitted, add it here in the same change: that classification is the decision, not a silent skip. Copy to memory/state/output-types.json and edit.
_substantive_means: true = human-facing, decision-bearing, fact-checkable content that a daily fact-check sampler should cover. false = automated ingestion, synthesis, logs, digests, internal system reports, memory operations (not fact-checkable from a cold start).

application.note: grant or job application draft: human-facing and fact-checkable

audit-report.note: internal system diagnostic; marking it true sweeps it into the fact-check sampler by mistake

reflection.note: internal reflection, not fact-checkable from a cold start

meta-memory-review.note: internal diagnostic, re-measures its own claims
